"'''To Do Good / Nubs and the Bumbling Bandits'''" is the fifth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Three|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[December 8]], [[2025]].

==Official description==
''[[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr]] is in trouble. [[Nubs]] races to catch bandits.''
